purpose: Document separate English/local-language searches, first-party local registry/cadastre evidence, and bounded anonymous geometry discovery.
assessment: First-party justice and land-property sources confirm a Sousse real-estate court branch and national land-property record services. The online services use registered-title and applicant identifiers; the map/topography pages reviewed did not expose safe anonymous full parcel geometry.
registryAssessment: First-party registry, cadastral or land-administration custodian route identified as described in the cited official-source observations; public safe geometry remains unverified.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Ministry of Justice page lists the Sousse Real Estate Court branch, its territorial jurisdiction over Sousse Governorate, and its role in voluntary/compulsory registration and cadastral-survey matters.
Official National Office of Land Property services provide parcel-title consultation, copies, certificates and transaction lists; title-number/identity-based services, not anonymous polygon access.
Official Office of Topography and Cadastre page lists geographic coverage, services, forms and access-to-information route; no public feature service was documented.
Ministry atlas page includes a Sousse governorate cartographic atlas; this is planning/cartographic material, not cadastral polygons.
